summary: Strong take: 60 of 64 notes on the right pitch, with a steady rhythm.
strengths: The opening phrase was clean and in tune
Long notes like "stream" and "grows" held steady

tips.title: Watch the accidentals
tips.explanation: The E natural in bar 14 came out as Eb, the Ab in bar 22 as A, and the F# in bar 13 was 41 cents flat.
tips.exercise: Circle every accidental, then sing bars 13–14 and 22 slowly with a piano.

tips.title: Land the key change
tips.explanation: After the switch to D major, the C# was 29 cents flat and bar 17 came in 150 ms early.
tips.exercise: Sing a D major scale before bar 16, and count a full beat before "Then".

tips.title: Centre the triplet and the tie
tips.explanation: The triplet's middle note was 32 cents flat; the tied D on "reeds" was 38 cents sharp and 180 ms late.
tips.exercise: Sing bars 6–7 slowly on one vowel against a click.
